notes: Fixes severe TV keyboard lag by reusing date formatters and showing search results in smaller pages.
Schedule loading now yields to typing and IME composition; the guide is not rebuilt behind open dialogs.
Startup reads saved schedules incrementally; slow wrestling metadata no longer blocks live scores or update requests on Android.
Alarm restoration runs off the UI thread; unchanged reminders are not repeatedly cancelled and scheduled.
TV startup keeps the system display mode and avoids expensive backdrop blur. Includes callback cleanup and rolling schedule-cache fixes.
